title.en: Morning at Home and Packing the Lamp

summary.en: You eat oatmeal with banana and tea while reviewing a lamp wiring sketch, then wrap the broken desk lamp in a towel and pack it with a screwdriver set. You grab an umbrella and jacket, notice something metallic by the door, pat your pockets, and leave.
summary.zh: 你在家吃了燕麦粥早餐，研究台灯接线草图，用毛巾包好坏台灯和螺丝刀套装，拿上伞和外套，出门前注意到门边有个金属小物件但没看清。

summary.en: You walk to the tram stop with an umbrella, then ride line 4 toward Fernhollow, checking the stop name and mumbling about getting off at Fernhollow.
summary.zh: 你步行到电车站，乘4路有轨电车前往Fernhollow，途中含糊地确认下车站点，录音嘈杂。

summary.en: At the repair cafe, a volunteer greets you and takes an intake form for the desk lamp, noting the flickering and cracked rocker switch.
summary.zh: 你到达蕨谷修理咖啡馆，志愿者接待你，你在纸质登记表上填写台灯闪、开关开裂的问题。

title.en: Opening the Lamp and Checking the Switch

summary.en: At the workbench, you and the volunteer open the lamp base and inspect the wiring; the volunteer finds the rocker switch cracked inside and arcing, and gets a multimeter to test the cord.
summary.zh: 你和志愿者打开台灯底座，发现摇臂开关内部开裂并打火，电线本身正常，准备用万用表测试。

title.en: Testing the Cord and Strain Relief

summary.en: The volunteer teaches you to test the cord for continuity; the meter beeps and the cord is good. You discuss strain relief and the knot inside the base.
summary.zh: 志愿者教你用万用表测试电源线，结果显示通路正常，你们讨论了底座内的应力消除结的作用。

summary.en: During a coffee break, you and the volunteer chat about the repair cafe's Saturday schedule, a spare-parts bin, and a toaster someone brought; you pause recording around midday for a break, returning at one.
summary.zh: 在茶点区，你和志愿者聊到修理咖啡馆每周六开放、备件箱和一台烤面包机，中午前后你暂停了记录。

summary.en: After the break, the volunteer searches the spare-parts bin for a matching rocker switch, but none fits the lamp's cutout.
summary.zh: 午休后继续，志愿者在备件箱翻找船型开关，但现有的开关尺寸或端子方向都不匹配灯座开口。

summary.en: The volunteer decides to order a replacement switch, expected Tuesday, and will text the tracking number; you agree to leave the lamp at the cafe until then.
summary.zh: 志愿者决定订购标准船型开关，预计周二到货，并会发物流单号给你；你同意把台灯留在咖啡馆直到那时。

title.en: Re-Seating the Cord and Tying a Knot

summary.en: Quiet focused work: you re-seat the cord, tie a strain-relief knot inside the base, and tidy the wires, keeping the four base screws in a small dish.
summary.zh: 你安静地重新装好电源线，在底座内打了应力消除结，整理了内部电线，四颗底座螺丝放在小碟里。

title.en: Storing Screws and Shelving the Lamp

summary.en: You put the four screws on the lid of a red toolbox for safekeeping; the volunteer confirms the toolbox stays on the bench. The lamp goes on the waiting-for-parts shelf with a blue tag until Tuesday, and you say goodbye.
summary.zh: 你把四颗螺丝放在红色工具箱盖上，志愿者确认工具箱会留到周二；台灯挂上蓝标签放到待料架，你们告别。

title.en: Bakery Stop for Bread and Cinnamon Buns

summary.en: Walking to the bakery in light drizzle, the cashier recommends the warm cinnamon buns. You buy a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns and lean the umbrella against the counter.
summary.zh: 你步行到羽毛笔街面包房，收银员推荐刚出炉的肉桂卷，你买了一个黑麦面包和两个肉桂卷，伞靠在柜台边。

title.en: Library Visit and Repair Manual Hold

summary.en: At the library holds desk, staff says the lamp repair manual will be ready Tuesday afternoon and renews your card. In the reading room, you browse a small appliance repair book.
summary.zh: 你到飞燕草社区图书馆取预约的小家电维修手册，工作人员说周二下午可拿并帮你续借；你在阅览室翻看了一本小家电维修书。

summary.en: You ride line 4 home in evening rain, muttering a reminder to pick up the switch at the repair cafe and the manual at the library on Tuesday afternoon.
summary.zh: 你乘4路有轨电车回家，晚上下雨，你低声提醒自己周二下午先去修理咖啡馆拿开关，再去图书馆取手册。

title.en: Dinner, Voice Note, and Evening Notes

summary.en: You return home, lean the wet umbrella by the door, and have soup with rye bread and a cinnamon bun. You record a voice note for Tuesday and later mumble about not seeing something by the door that morning.
summary.zh: 你回家后把湿伞靠在门边，晚餐喝了汤配黑麦面包，吃了一个肉桂卷；录下语音备忘提醒周二取开关和手册，又在本子上列了明日清单。

en.headline: Repair cafe lamp fix, tram errands, bakery and library stop.

places.text: Morning started at home with oatmeal and notes about a lamp switch.
Taken across town on tram line 4 toward Fernhollow.
Spent most of the day at Fernhollow Repair Cafe working on a desk lamp.
Stopped at Quill Street Bakery for a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns.
Visited Larkspur Community Library for a hold and card renewal.

activities.text: Had breakfast at home while reviewing a hand-drawn lamp wiring sketch.
Prepared to leave with an umbrella and jacket.
At the repair cafe, opened the desk lamp, removed four screws, tested the cord with a multimeter, and ordered a replacement switch.
Left the lamp on the waiting-for-parts shelf and kept the screws on the red toolbox.
Bought a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns at Quill Street Bakery.
At the library, learned the reserved lamp repair manual would be ready Tuesday and the library card was renewed.

people.text: The repair cafe volunteer helped diagnose the cracked switch, tested the cord, and said the replacement switch would arrive Tuesday.
The bakery staff member offered warm cinnamon buns and repeated the order.
The library staff member said the reserved manual would be ready Tuesday afternoon and renewed the library card.

Some low-confidence detections of screws on or near the red toolbox were recorded.

en.a: You and Pip fixed the scooter's soft wheel: the bearing was cleaned, the axle greased, and the wheel spun free; Pip did the last screw while you held the frame steady.

en.q: When did I make dumplings with the neighbors?
en.a: The records show dumpling making for a neighborhood dinner on February 13, but the folding session that day names family, not neighbors; another folding session on February 17 includes other people but does not label them as neighbors.

en.q: What did the swim coach say about my stroke?
en.a: The coach had you breathe every third stroke instead of every second, and it got easier. You were told to slow your kick in the last length, and the coach corrected your catch so you practiced a slower catch while being watched from the lane end. Most recently the coach set a slow kick drill, with you counting tiles between breaths.

en.q: Did I finish exporting the year book?
en.a: You exported a first draft of the year book earlier on. The full export later finished, with a bound copy ordered for the shelf above the bench.

en.q: Where did I last see the red toolbox?
en.a: The latest record of the red toolbox puts it in your home workshop, where you tested a radio's power cord and sanded cabinet doors. It had moved there from the Fernhollow Repair Cafe bench and, before that, the tram.

en.q: What did I do on New Year's Eve?
en.a: You spent New Year's Eve at Sis's house, fixing a wobbly chair leg while Pip held the lamp. Dov cooked too much again, and the year ended with a countdown at the kitchen table. The tree lights stayed on through the countdown and everyone clinked glasses at the table.

zh.a: 你最近一次去游泳是在周日，到社区游泳馆游泳，教练建议放慢打腿。

zh.q: 八月那次卷尺最后是在哪儿找到的？
zh.a: 那次卷尺最后是在工作间的帆布袋里找到的；记录说“午饭后果然在那儿找到了”。

zh.q: 感恩节那天都有谁在？
zh.a: 你在姐姐家过感恩节，外甥皮皮也在。记录还提到“姐姐他们”要求祝酒时暂停，但没说明具体都有谁。

zh.q: 我和小琼在装订课上做了什么？
zh.a: 你们在装订课交流缝线、胶水和本子做法：她把做的本子、新缝笔记本给你看，你们交换不裂胶心得，你也把缝线图抄在笔记页边。她还教过你补撕破修理手册的针法，并一起对照笔记本里的简单缝法图。

zh.a: 证据显示你在一月买了万用表：当时在五金店比较两只表，挑了刻度更清楚、表笔更简单的那只；后来也提到是一月买的。

zh.q: 我给拉家的孩子们修了哪些万圣节服装？
zh.a: 你给拉家的孩子们补过戏服袖子，还粘亮片补过斗篷。试机器人手臂时，你也补粘过松开的腕带。

zh.q: 我和皮皮把他的滑板车修了哪儿？
zh.a: 你们修的是滑板车轮：把轴承清干净、给车轴上油，让轮子转得顺，最后一颗螺丝由皮皮拧。

zh.q: 我是哪天和邻居们一起包饺子的？
zh.a: 你是二月十七日包饺子的。邻居奥阿姨带来饺子馅并示范褶子，拉家的孩子们也一起捏。

zh.q: 游泳教练是怎么说我的划水动作的？
zh.a: 教练纠正过你的划水，让你练更慢的抓水，并在泳道尽头看着你。他还让你只数划水次数、不追时间，后来要求每三划换一次气。

zh.q: 年度相册我导出完了吗？
zh.a: 导出完了：年度册导出完成，导出也已跑完。

zh.q: 红色工具箱最后一次是在哪儿看到的？
zh.a: 最后一次看到红色工具箱是在家里的工作间。

zh.q: 跨年夜那天我做了什么？
zh.a: 你带着小工具和一盘小面包坐4路有轨电车去姐姐家。在姐姐家你修一只晃动的椅腿，外甥帮你举台灯，姐夫同时做三样菜。晚上树灯亮着，大家在厨房桌边倒数、碰杯。
